views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said UMG turned off music on TikTok to stop being ripped off and highlighted how much the company does for its artists.

views.text: In September 2023, Equity Mates explained UMG's Deezer deal where streams from professional artists count double and user-searched plays double again, so an actively searched Taylor Swift song would be counted as four streams for royalties.
